# The one grammar's allowlist (nova-tools#4352 A; docs/STYLE-CLI.md; the class
# test is internal/ci/clistyle_class_test.go). One row per finding the tools
# other than nova-sprint still carry today, tool<TAB>rule<TAB>verb<TAB>flag.
# The list only shrinks: an unlisted finding is red, and a row whose finding
# has left is stale and also red. nova-sprint never has a row here. Each
# tool comes over one card at a time (remove its rows as it does).
